findings.title: No SBOM/provenance artifact or release manifest is published for the pack itself
evidence: no sbom/ directory or CycloneDX file in tree
VERSION=1.5.0 and CHANGELOG.md exist but no per-release SBOM/provenance
findings.impact: Consumers vendoring the pack cannot verify its contents via a published manifest beyond PACK_DIGEST.txt.
findings.recommendation: Emit a CycloneDX SBOM and a signed release manifest per tagged pack release.

report: The pack ships no runtime dependencies (stdlib-only Python), but it also publishes no SBOM or provenance for its own releases; it audits others' SBOMs.
